players.bio: Ben Hughes is a 22-year-old Welsh professional goalkeeper currently playing for League One club Cambridge United.. He joined the club on 1 July 2025 on a two-year contract after departing Swansea City.
Benjamin Leo Knight (born 14 June 2002) is an English professional footballer who plays as a striker for EFL League One club Cambridge United.
Callum Perry is a 20-year-old professional footballer who plays for Cambridge United on a season-long loan from Coventry City .
Callum Lee Stead is an English professional football player who plays as a forward for Cambridge United.
Cathal Séan Heffernan Andrews (born 27 April 2005) is an Irish footballer who plays as a centre-back for Cambridge United.

Dominic Martin Ball (born 2 August 1995) is an English professional footballer who plays for League One club Cambridge United. He plays primarily as a defensive midfielder but can also play as a centre-back or at full-back.
Gabriel Hendrix Breeze (born 30 December 2003) is an English footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL League One club Cambridge United.

Gassan Ahadme Yahyai (born 17 November 2000) is a professional footballer who plays as a second-striker for EFL League One club Cambridge United on loan from EFL Championship club Charlton Athletic. Born in Spain, he represented Morocco at youth international level. Club career Early career Born in Vic, Spain, Ahadme began his career with Norwich City, spending time on loan at Real Oviedo B.

George David Hoddle (born 06 September 2005) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League One club Cambridge United.. He has played on loan at St Neots Town, Royston Town, St Albans City and Bedford Town.
Glenn McConnell (born 26 April 2005) is an Irish professional footballer currently playing as a forward for Cambridge United.
Isaac Theodor Lambie Heath (born 28 October 2004) is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for club Cambridge United.

Jake Eastwood (born 3 October 1996) is an English footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL League One club Cambridge United. Sheffield born Jake Eastwood is a graduate of Sheffield United's youth academy. In his youth, he has spent time on loan with Sheffield FC, Gainsborough Trinity and Mickleover Sports for first team experience.
Kelland John William James Watts (born 3 November 1999) is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL League One side Cambridge United.

Liam Bennett (born 30 November 2001) is an English professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Cambridge United. He spent the start of the 2022/23 season out on loan at League Two side Walsall, where they found themselves in play off places contention after a run of unbeaten games. Unfortunately for the Saddler’s, Cambridge recalled their man in form at the end of December 2022.

Louis George P. Appéré is a Scottish footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League One club Cambridge United. Early life Louis Appéré was born in Perth on 26 March 1999. He grew up in Cupar, Fife, where he attended Bell Baxter High School. He started playing football for East Fife Junior Supporters' Club at the age of 9 and later spent two years as a youth player with Dunfermline Athletic.
Mamadou Ousmane Jobe is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL League One club Stockport County.

Neil Harris (born 12 July 1977) is an English professional football manager and former footballer who played as a striker. He is currently head coach of Cambridge United. Harris is Millwall's all-time record goalscorer, with 138 goals in all competitions. He broke the previous record of 111 goals, held by Teddy Sheringham, on 13 January 2009, during a 3–2 away win at Crewe Alexandra.

Owen James Moxon is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League One club Cambridge United, on loan from EFL League One club Stockport County. Moxon has previously played for Queen of the South, Gretna 2008, Annan Athletic and Carlisle United.

Patrick Bauer (born 28 October 1992) is a German professional footballer who plays as a centre back for {EFL League One club Cambridge United. In May 2011 Patrick Bauer extended his contract with VfB Stuttgart until June 2015. On 29 July 2011 Bauer had his debut for the first team of VfB Stuttgart in the first round of the 2011–12 DFB-Pokal against SV Wehen Wiesbaden.

Pelly Ruddock Mpanzu (born 22 March 1994) is a professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for EFL League One club Cambridge United. He is the first footballer to climb from the non-league tiers of English football to the Premier League with the same club, having joined Luton in 2013.

Ra'ees Mekhi Elijah Bangura-Williams (born 2 July 2004) is an English-born professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or winger for EFL League One club Cambridge United, on loan from EFL Championship club Millwall.

Sam Curtis is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a right-back or centre-back for EFL League One club Cambridge United, on loan from EFL Championship club Sheffield United. He began his senior career with League of Ireland Premier Division club St Patrick's Athletic. He is the League of Ireland's youngest ever player.[

Shane Daniel McLoughlin is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a defender or midfielder for Cambridge United. McLoughlin was born in New York City, where his family lived in the Bronx. He moved to County Kerry, Republic of Ireland, when he was five years old. McLaughlin represented the Republic of Ireland at under-16 and under-18 levels.

Shayne Francis Lavery (born 8 December 1998) is a Northern Irish professional footballer who plays as a striker for Cambridge United. He has also represented the Northern Ireland national team. He has previously played for Everton, Falkirk and Linfield.

Sulaiman Borbor "Sullay" Kaikai (born 26 August 1995) is a professional footballer who plays as a winger for League One club Cambridge United. Born in England, he represents the Sierra Leone national football team. A youth product of Crystal Palace, he made his senior debut on loan at Crawley Town in 2014, and later that year scored on his Palace debut.
Zak Dominic Bradshaw (born 22 September 2003) is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL League One club Cambridge United.
